# MT5 Analyzer

> Independent MetaTrader 5 backtest report analysis, EA validation and trading-tool builds by Dhashan Naidoo.

Key pages:
- [Free MT5 report analyzer](https://mt5-analyzer.dhashan.workers.dev/): drop a Strategy Tester HTML report; metrics are computed in the browser and the file is never uploaded.
- [Validation service](https://mt5-analyzer.dhashan.workers.dev/order): $29 health check, $99 validation, $249 full study. Fixed scope and a written verdict.
- [Sample report](https://mt5-analyzer.dhashan.workers.dev/sample-report): a real failure, published in full with the out-of-sample numbers.
- [Walk-forward validation](https://mt5-analyzer.dhashan.workers.dev/walk-forward-validation): how the rolling split and efficiency number work.
- [AI search visibility audit](https://mt5-analyzer.dhashan.workers.dev/ai-visibility): samples ChatGPT and Google AI answers for buyer prompts and audits the technical layer behind them, from $49.
- [About](https://mt5-analyzer.dhashan.workers.dev/about): who does the work and what is not promised.
- [Contact](https://mt5-analyzer.dhashan.workers.dev/contact): what to send and the response time.
- [Source handling](https://mt5-analyzer.dhashan.workers.dev/source-handling): NDA, storage and deletion.
